audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 are credited to Yorick though both whys say Nautilus wins them, and Level 6 is 'Skill' though its why calls it Yorick's hardest spike.
audit.why: Before Eulogy of the Isles, Yorick has one ghoul and no cage-plus-Maiden combination; at 6 the Maiden and four Mist Walkers overwhelm single-target CC.
Spikes read level 3, level 6 Maiden, his first item side-lane trap and his late split — the correct order.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites' heal and auto-reset are never mentioned, and Dark Procession is tracked without its cooldown or its destructibility.
audit.why: Last Rites (Q, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) heals him on the empowered attack and resets the auto, so the wind-up is the trade tell and Grievous Wounds decides extended trades. Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) is a destructible wall — you can break it rather than wait it out.
audit.corrected: Number the 20s cage, say it is destructible, and make anti-heal explicit for Last Rites.

edits.before: Q-hook him off Maiden — W-shield ghoul autos. Nautilus wins the Dark Procession cooldown windows.
edits.after: Hook Yorick himself, never a ghoul — anti-heal Last Rites and fight while the cage is down.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 20s cage, and it is destructible — break it or bait it, then engage.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you and speeds his ghouls in — sidestep it, then the cage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Last Rites heals him every 4-6s — bring Grievous Wounds to this lane.

notes: Chart rows 1, 2 and 4 flipped as a paired group to match the packet chart and the existing whys. Added Last Rites' heal/auto-reset and the fact that Dark Procession is a destructible 20s wall.
